image_description: A side-profile view of a large American bison standing on a gravel path. The animal features a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump and a beard. The hindquarters are smoother and less furred. Short curved horns are visible on the broad head. In the background, other bison are grazing in a green field.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, showing a broad profile and short, curved horns consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, dark beard of long hair hangs from the chin and throat area.
The eye is visible as a dark spot amidst the facial fur.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and blended into the thick head fur, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic massive build and height at the shoulders relative to the hips.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark fur, creating a very distinct and high shoulder hump.
There is a clear visual transition where the fur on the rear half of the body is significantly shorter and smoother than the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are visibly short and stout relative to the massive size of the head and body.
The legs appear sturdy and black/dark. While the ground texture makes individual hoof splits hard to resolve perfectly, the general shape and stance are anatomically correct for a bovid.
The tail is visible hanging down, ending in a distinct dark, bushy switch/tuft.
